positions.title: Lead iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Fullscreen is a global media company that provides services to change the way content is produced, distributed, and consumed by more than 600 million massively engaged subscribers.
iOS Developer/ Sr. iOS Developer/ Lead iOS Developer
•	Worked on multiple iOS SVOD apps (Fullscreen SVOD app featured in the App Store throughout the year 2016)
•	Worked on two Apple TV projects (one of the apps named as the 10 best apps in 2016 in the App Store)

•	Worked on Android projects

positions.title: iOS Developer/Engineer
positions.description:
Kuapay.com
Kuapay is a mobile payment application that lets people make fast, secure payments with their smartphone wherever credit cards are accepted.
iPhone Application Development (Full time)
•	Updating and refactoring the codes for the existing mobile payment app
•	POS integration for iPhone and iPad
•	Integrating with third party POS systems such as Micros, Positouch and Dinerware
•	Core Data for data storage
•	Implementing XML through socket connection/Http request to API
•	Map view integration
•	Korean language support
•	CardIO/Card reader implementation
•	Graph
•	Experience with framework/library: Core Data, GDataXML, Zbar , CardIO, CorePlot

positions.title: iOS Application Developer, Flash/ActionScript3 Programmer
positions.description:
Wowbuild.com
Developer of software for e-commerce, advertising and distribution of digital content for mobile devices and the web - Clients include Warner Brothers, MTV, Paramount Pictures.
iOS Application Developer, Flash/ActionScript3 Programmer

• iPhone Application Development
Created company’s UI template and Game template for future/potential iPhone applications
Created a simple iPad Game for Pesi – Ad Hoc distributions for client’s convention display
• Developed Flash Games for MTV using ActionScript 3 and Backend UI for uploading game assets using PHP, JavaScript and JQuery
• Experience with framework/library: Cocos2d, Box2d, Three20, FacebookGraph, Cocoa Touch, OpenGLES, Bullet Physics

positions.title: iPhone Application Development (Contract)
positions.description:
• Created a barcode scanning/rendering app using open sources.
• Main Developer. Developed from scratch
• Facebook/Twitter integration
• Core Data for data storage
• Ad Hoc distribution using TestFlight for the client’s review/test
• Experience with framework/library: iOS5 API (storyboard and ARC), Zbar iPhone SDK, Cocoa-Touch-Barcodes

positions.title: iOS Application Development (Contract)
positions.description:
Spot100.com is a portal site dedicated to the Korean-Community.

• Created a coupon app - Location based. Facebook/Twitter integration
• Main Developer and project manager
• Built a web API (JSON) and setup databases for data processing using PHP, MySQL
• Provided UI design guidance to junior designer
• Application submission process
• Ad Hoc distribution using TestFlight for the client’s review/test
• Experience with framework/library: iOS5 API (storyboard and ARC), ASIHttpRequest
